resolved_validation_failures: Site pack used a stale omui-gen path after the actual rebuilt tool landed in another configuration directory. Re-selected via mcpp --print-launch; real graph-based font packaging then passed.
Foundation graph audit now distinguishes exact host-only embed/plan/rules/gen entries from target packages; host tool sources remain forbidden in target CDB.
Vector generated-source audit now includes effect shaders as well as drawing shaders.
Renderer test dependencies moved to a separate temporary integration consumer, keeping testing out of the production graph.
Std/path-only core feature consumers legitimately produce no registry lock; repeated locked builds and unchanged absence are verified.
open_release_issue: mcpp pack omits local path dependency edges. CLDR/i18n exposed GNU ld archive-order failure. The fixture supplies explicit dependencies and a GNU rescan group; package metadata/interfaces remain unmodified. Automatic top-level-only installation is not accepted.
limits: This checkpoint adds no animation/effect/demo completion counts and makes no new aesthetic, realtime performance or clean-build speed claim.
Linux GCC16 and Emscripten/Node/Chromium validation; Windows/macOS/mobile and physical GPUs are not qualified by it.
C++ source imports remain after rebuild; removed child package keys and CLI selectors migrate to the product/features. No binary ABI/BMI guarantee.
Source features are additive across edges; packaged features are frozen, not reselected in the precompiled archive.
